prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: one contiguous top-down ground-only game terrain outpaint for Safety Last.

INPUTS: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 1666 × 1924 portrait template. The leftmost 260 pixels are the actual existing northern works edge. The bottom 256 pixels are the actual works yard edge. The white area is missing ground between them. Fill that white area, preserving both adjoining sides, their position, scale and road entries. Preserve the leftmost 132 pixels and bottommost 128 pixels exactly. Image 2 is the material and scale reference, the approved works yard. Image 3 is a geographic guide only: we are filling a small open meadow between works approaches, not drawing the full world.

ONE PATH ONLY: Continue the narrow dirt path entering from the LEFT around 47% of the full image height. Curve it gently across the lower half toward the existing dirt path entering from the BOTTOM at roughly 73% width. Match both actual entry points, widths, material and direction. It should feel like a modest worn shortcut between two existing destinations. NO forks, intersections, branches, loop, new northbound road, eastern road, paving or road grid. Do not add a path along any edge. Keep the northern half entirely free of roads. Keep the right side beyond the curved path as uninterrupted open ground too.

OPEN WORLD GROUND: This must be visibly less dominated by paths than the earlier terrain. Most new land is broad connected stretches of muted olive and subdued green grass surface, mixed with irregular exposed brown soil and a few deeper cool umber patches. Leave generous calm areas that a player can freely walk through away from the path, with room for later separately placed trees, resources and wildlife. The upper and central ground should have little pebbly clutter and softly varied hand-painted earth/grass texture, not a decorative mosaic of stones or individual raised leaf shapes. Keep the same top-down painted game style, fine material scale and neutral daylight as the real contacts. Transition naturally from the existing west and south soil colours; no straight colour boundary, uniform orange tint or rectangular patch. No new red or orange leaves. No flowers.

NO buildings, fences, foundations, rails, props, trees, shrubs, raised grass tufts, big rocks, water, puddles, animals, people, vehicles, shadows from objects, text, grid, border, panels, black fade, vignette or unfilled white space. Ground surface plus just the single connecting dirt path. Keep the supplied contact artwork fixed and the northern half road-free. Output a single opaque portrait image at 1666:1924 aspect ratio, highest available resolution, ideally 1666 × 1924 or larger.

references.editTarget: scripts/prepare-works-meadow.mjs reconstructs the west and south contacts at (8314,456), 1666 × 1924.
